title: Enneper Minimal Surface
formula: x = u - u³/3 + uv², y = -v + v³/3 - vu², z = u² - v²
latex: x = u - \frac{u^3}{3} + uv^2,\quad y = -v + \frac{v^3}{3} - vu^2,\quad z = u^2 - v^2
parametric_fn: (u, v, target) => { const x = u - (u * u * u) / 3.0 + u * (v * v); const y = -v + (v * v * v) / 3.0 - v * (u * u); const z = u * u - v * v; target.set(x, z, -y).multiplyScalar(0.55); }
